pairs.question: Quid miseros homines et laboriosos viatores tam crudelibus animis invaditis atque obteritis? Quas praedas inhiatis? Quae damna vindicatis? At non speluncas ferarum vel cautes incolitis barbarorum, ut humano sanguine profuso gaudeatis.
pairs.answer: At nos non vestrorum spoliorum cupidine latrocinamur, sed hanc ipsam cladem de vestris protelamus manibus.
pairs.derivation: The husband, under attack from dogs and stones, protests with a contiguous plea containing genuine interrogatives (Quid... invaditis? Quas praedas inhiatis? Quae damna vindicatis?); quoted entire and verbatim as the question. A villager from the cypress-top answers, explaining their motive. Dropped the framing 'inquit' (and the preceding 'Vnus illinc denique de summo cupressus cacumine:'). Answer ends at the first full stop ('...manibus.'); the following sentence 'Iam denique pace tranquilla securi potestis incedere.' is a follow-on reassurance, not part of the direct answer to why they attacked, so it is cut.
